candidates.change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.1"; }

candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that assigns _number to number, so number keeps its previous value.
Assign _number to sequenceNumber instead of number (number no longer receives _number's value).
Remove the assignment to timestamp so it never updates.
Assign the _timestamp value into number instead of timestamp, leaving timestamp at its old value.
Invert the modifier's check so the depositor is rejected and non-depositors allowed, so a depositor call reverts and timestamp stays unchanged.
Remove the statement `basefee = _basefee;` so basefee is never updated.
Replace the basefee assignment with `basefee = _number;` so it stores the block number instead of the base fee.
Replace the basefee assignment with `basefee = _l1FeeScalar;` so it stores the L1 fee scalar instead of the base fee.
Drop the `onlyDepositor` modifier invocation so any caller can set L1 block values.
Invert the require condition to `msg.sender != DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT` so the depositor's call reverts and basefee is never set.
